name: Lantern Night Market
desc: A rice-paper lantern night market seen down its length: rows of stalls telescope into warm sodium haze, catenary lantern strings sway at every depth, steam lifts off the food carts, and the whole scene is doubled in the wet stone underfoot; a warm paper-lantern night, a cool Hopper nocturne, a flat ukiyo-e woodblock, a hot smoky ember night, or a monochrome sumi ink wash.

energy.doc: how hard the lanterns burn — bloom size, flicker amplitude and steam luminance

scale.doc: stall and lantern size — from a distant deep market to big close stalls filling the frame

density.doc: how many stalls, lanterns per string, and steam plumes crowd the scene

speed.doc: parallax drift rate down the market — near stalls always slide faster than far ones

haze.doc: atmosphere — aerial-perspective fade with depth and how much steam veils the far stalls

wet.doc: wet-stone reflectivity — 0 dries the ground, 1 mirrors every lantern in a rain-slick floor

hue.doc: primary warm hue of the lantern light and ground glow

x.doc: where the warm ground glow pools and the wet sheen centres

y.doc: the ground line — how much frame is sky and lanterns versus wet floor

style.doc: aesthetic: lantern = warm paper-lantern night, deep teal-navy sky; noir = cool desaturated Hopper nocturne with one sodium key; ukiyo = flat ukiyo-e woodblock, indigo + vermilion, paper grain; ember = hot smoky reds with heavy steam; ink = abstracted warm-grey sumi wash, lanterns as soft ink halos

seed.doc: regenerates the stall layout, lantern spacing and steam

alpha.doc: layer opacity — fades the whole market back behind the performers
